title: The Verdict of the Fens
author: Noor Eastwick
blurb: Ines Halloran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
